interface.signature: def check_vowel(s: str, n: int) -> bool

preconditions.description: The first argument s must be a string.
The second argument n must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (n >= 0 and n < len(s) and s[n].lower() in 'aeiou')
postconditions.description: Returns True if and only if n is a valid non-negative index within the string and the character at that position is a vowel (case-insensitive); otherwise returns False.
